senses.gloss: (b. h.) to melt, flow; to cause running off, effect curdling.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 25</cite> <he>שלא יִמְסֶה</he> that the manna might not melt.—Denom. <cite ref="M01855"><he>מְסוֹ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 6:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. VI, 7</cite> <he>התחיל בוכה ומַמְסֶה מטתו וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (ed. <he>וממחה</he>) he began to weep and make his bed flow with (his) tears; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 636">Yalk. Ps. 636</cite>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7:9">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> (play on <cite ref="M01886"><he>מַסּוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 29:2">Deut. XXIX, 2</cite>) <he>המכות מְמַסּוֹת גופיהן וכ׳</he> the plagues weakened the bodies of the Egyptians; Yalk. ib. 940.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:4">Tosef. Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>ירכה נִמְסֵית</he> her thigh will fall away.
